convention.frame: x forward, y left, z up, metres; the hull box is centred on x = 0, y = 0 and stands on z = 0
convention.hull_box: the top is max(the real hull or turret roof, the top of the tallest bulky dressing - 0.3 m) (decisions.md C4, after F-B1). Sights, sensors, radars and roof guns that are not a roster mount are dressing, held to unitArt.ts's 0.3 m bulky / 0.15 m thin allowance. The box covers the body, including an armoured turret overhang (FC8)
convention.pivot: the centre of the turret ring; for a fixed mount, the trunnion or hinge it is drawn on (only pivot + muzzle reaches the simulation)
convention.muzzle: muzzle_m is measured from the mount's pivot: the simulation fires from pivot + muzzle (crates/sim/src/weapons/muzzle.rs:12-22; decisions.md C5)
convention.eye: the sight's height over the ground (catalog.rs:181); kept unless a source contradicts it (FA-6)

thresholds.hull_dimension: fix when off by more than max(0.10 m, 3 %)
thresholds.pivot: fix when off by more than 0.15 m on any axis
thresholds.muzzle_point: fix when the world muzzle point (pivot + muzzle) is off by more than 0.15 m on any axis; a value written in another convention is fixed whatever its size (C5)
thresholds.eye_m: kept unless a source contradicts it
thresholds.note: One set for every lane (decisions.md C10). The lanes' own variants (F-A's max(0.10 m, 3 %) for muzzles, F-C's 0.30 m muzzle reach) are retired.

verdicts.keep: the frame number agrees with the references within the thresholds
verdicts.fix: slice 15 changes it to `new`: a row in fix-rows.json, or the parent's row where the fixture takes the field through extends
verdicts.unresolved: kept at today's value: nothing measures it well enough to move it; named
verdicts.art-only: not a frame number: the family slice fixes the art
verdicts.inherits: the fixture extends another unit and this appearance takes its rows

overlays.note: Registered overlay: the drawing is scaled by its hull length set to `registration.span_m` and anchored on the nose and ground line; the model silhouette (vehicle mode) and the frame box are laid over it. Stations sample 19 points along the span: the top (z) in side and front views, the full width in the top view, drawing against model. Drawing silhouettes include roof fittings, antennas, the gun and, where the crop catches them, dimension arrows. The overlay images contain the copyrighted drawing, so they are not committed. The profile is in colour, so its silhouette is the non-white area (threshold 0.93) and it has no separate line work.

notes.note: (known before the walk) the frame is 3.0 m tall against about 2.6 m in photos
notes.why: KNDS gives 2.64 m (2A6, 2A7) and 2.72 m (2A8) to the turret roof; the box top moves to 2.70 m (2A6) and 2.83 m (2A7V, 2A8) so the PERI stays within the dressing allowance.

answers.Q4: No: over the real roof the PERI's top stands 0.36 m (2A6: about 3.0 m over 2.64 m) and 0.41 m (2A8: 3.13 m over 2.72 m) up, past the 0.3 m bulky allowance; the PERI head is about 0.4 m across, so it is not thin. The fix sets each box top at the PERI's top less 0.3 m (2.70 m and 2.83 m), within 0.06 m and 0.11 m of the roofs, so the PERI fits exactly. The 2A8 inherits the 2A7V frame, including the 8.05 m hull with the armour module that both carry. The art must put the PERI under a dressing_* node.
